_note: Objects of standard size for fixing a 3D clip's scale (civil/scene_scale.py). PROVISIONAL LIST, 2026-11-20: typical sizes, not yet checked against a cited standard. Every entry is marked provisional, has no source URL and a wide tolerance, and the app says so next to it. Replace this file with the Research Desk catalog (Project_CIVIL/research/scene-scale-references.json: id, name_en, name_th, dimension_name, value_m, tolerance_m or spread, rel_error, plane, visibility, region, source_urls, source_dates, notes) when it is ready. CIVIL_SCENE_REFS can point to another file. The custom known distance is always added by the app. vertical: true marks a height (only the vertical part of the two tapped 3D points is used).

objects.name_th: ความกว้างช่องจราจร ทางหลวง
objects.dimension_name: centre of one lane line to the centre of the next
objects.source_note: provisional: typical through-lane width on Thai national highways; no standard cited yet
objects.notes: Tap the centres of the two lines straight across the lane, not diagonally.

objects.name_en: Lane width, city or local road
objects.name_th: ความกว้างช่องจราจร ถนนในเมือง/ท้องถิ่น
objects.dimension_name: centre of one lane line to the centre of the next
objects.source_note: provisional: typical urban lane width; local roads vary
objects.notes: Lane widths vary from road to road: a tape measurement (custom distance) is better.

objects.name_th: ความกว้างเส้นขอบทาง
objects.dimension_name: width of the painted edge line
objects.source_note: provisional: solid edge lines of 10 to 20 cm are in use
objects.notes: Short: only useful on a frame where the line is close and sharp. Tap across the line.

objects.name_th: ความกว้างเส้นแบ่งทิศทาง/เส้นแบ่งช่องจราจร
objects.source_note: provisional: lines of 10 to 15 cm are common
objects.notes: Short: only useful when the line is close and sharp. Tap across the line.

objects.name_th: ความยาวเส้นประ 1 ช่วง (ทางหลวง)
objects.dimension_name: one painted dash, end to end
objects.source_note: provisional: 3 m dashes are usual on high-speed roads; urban dashes are often shorter
objects.notes: Tap both ends of the same dash, along the road.

objects.name_th: ความกว้างแถบทางม้าลาย
objects.source_note: provisional: stripes of 30 to 50 cm are common
objects.notes: Tap across one stripe, along the direction of travel.

objects.name_th: ความกว้างเส้นหยุด
objects.source_note: provisional: stop lines of 20 to 40 cm are common

objects.name_th: ความสูงขอบทาง (คันหิน)
objects.dimension_name: road surface to the top of the kerb
objects.source_note: provisional: raised kerbs are usually 15 to 20 cm high; resurfacing makes them lower
objects.notes: Tap the foot of the kerb on the road and the top edge right above it. A tape measurement is better.

objects.name_th: ฝาท่อระบายน้ำ (กลม)
objects.source_note: provisional: round covers of about 60 cm are common; sizes vary by utility
objects.notes: Tap two opposite edges through the centre.

objects.name_th: ความกว้างป้ายทะเบียนรถยนต์ไทย
objects.dimension_name: plate width, left edge to right edge
objects.source_note: provisional: 34 x 15 cm is the size usually quoted for Thai car plates; not yet checked against the Department of Land Transport rule
objects.notes: Only on a parked car close to the camera. Tap the two side edges of the plate.

objects.name_th: ความสูงป้ายทะเบียนรถยนต์ไทย
objects.dimension_name: plate height, bottom edge to top edge
objects.source_note: provisional: 34 x 15 cm is the size usually quoted for Thai car plates; not yet checked against the Department of Land Transport rule
objects.notes: Short: only on a plate close to the camera.

objects.name_th: เส้นผ่านศูนย์กลางล้อรถยนต์นั่ง
objects.source_note: provisional: most passenger-car tyres are 0.58 to 0.70 m across
objects.notes: Tap the top of the tyre and where it touches the road.

objects.name_th: กรวยจราจร 70 ซม.
objects.source_note: provisional: 70 cm is a common road-works cone; 45 cm and 90 cm cones also exist
objects.notes: Check which size the cone is. Tap where it stands on the road and its tip.
